data class Evidence(val leg: String, val scope: Map<String, String>, val gather_verdict: String, val graded_findings: List<String>, val examined: List<String>, val plan_kts: String)

fun plan(): Evidence {
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val gather = readGather(taskContext)
    val feedback = readFeedback(taskContext)
    val findings = gradeFindings(gather, feedback)
    val evidence = makeEvidence(leg = "mm-compliance", scope = emptyMap(), gather = gather, findings = findings)
    writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", value = evidence)
    val completion = noop(message = "No action needed: mm-compliance judge evidence written with no gather divergences to grade")
    return evidence
}
